Boxer Lovlina Borgohain flags incorrect India map at Glasgow restaurant

Indian boxer Lovlina Borgohain expressed hurt after noticing that a map of India on napkins at a Glasgow restaurant omitted the Northeast region. The incident occurred during a celebratory dinner for the Indian boxing contingent following their performance at the Commonwealth Games 2026. The restaurant, Mister Singh's India, reportedly acknowledged the mistake and apologized. The Indian Boxing Federation also reacted to the incident. The restaurant's Instagram account was later deleted.
